title: GARASU: Glass Aging, Relaxation And Simulation Utility
description: GARASU computes and fits glass relaxation dynamics with structural relaxation models: the heterogeneous Takeda–Lucas (TL) model, the Tool–Narayanaswamy–Moynihan (TNM) model and RelaxPy (MAP viscosity). It contains four tools: Learn (experiments and models with live simulations), Lab (interactive cool/heat, anneal and T-jump runs), Fitter (any thermal history, experimental data, compute or fit with uncertainties) and Data Analysis (raw DSC heat flow to normalized heat capacity, fictive temperature and recovered enthalpy; property relaxation). It runs in the browser and as a desktop app for macOS and Windows.
